title: Slayer of Madhu and Kaitabha
translation: Salutations to you who routed Madhu and Kaitabha, who gave a boon to Brahma. Give me beauty, give me victory, give me glory, destroy my enemies.
translation_hi: मधु और कैटभ को भगाने वाली, ब्रह्मा को वर देने वाली देवी, आपको नमस्कार है। मुझे रूप दीजिए, जय दीजिए, यश दीजिए, शत्रुओं का नाश कीजिए।

words.note: Accusative plural of dvish (hater). Same root as dvesha.

grammar: The refrain begins: every verse from here ends रूपं देहि जयं देहि यशो देहि द्विषो जहि. Its word cards are in this verse.
Chapter 1 in one line: the Saptashati's first story is the slaying of Madhu and Kaitabha. Each verse of the Argala recalls one story.
